entities.summary: Joseph Louis "Joe L." Hensley was an American lawyer, prosecuting attorney, member of the Indiana General Assembly, circuit court judge, science fiction fan, and writer of science fiction and mysteries. He was a long-time resident of Madison, Indiana, and died there of complications of leukemia.
